threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the 67 bus is reliable; locals know it's a gamble. Only true veterans trust the Overground over buses in a pinch.
Last night on the 133, an old bloke sang the entire 'Bohemian Rhapsody' while a couple argued whether it was a classic or a joke. Classic South London night.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a kid selling lemonade on a busy corner while a hipster DJ spun tunes from a portable speaker—classic Neukölln chaos.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find a Kebab stand thriving next to a Michelin-starred restaurant, both packed at 2 AM. The city's food scene is wild.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by their reaction to a BART delay. It’s just another Tuesday, while those from out of town are panicking on the platform.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Riding the 31 today, a guy pulled out a mini speaker and started DJing. The whole aisle turned into a dance floor. Classic SF moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just stop in the middle of the street to take selfies; locals know to keep moving or risk a collision with the nearest scooter.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You’ll see them at the markets, struggling to pronounce 'patata' while insisting on paying with coins they think are worth more than they are.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still wait for the bus at the stop instead of walking two feet to the curb. The locals glide past, it's like a dance they mastered long ago.
Last night on the 59, a bloke serenaded the bus with an acoustic guitar. Didn’t catch his name, but he definitely knew all the classics.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was really home when I saw a guy using his skateboard to carry groceries while chatting up a street musician outside the Rewe.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do they stop trains for spontaneous dance parties on the U-Bahn. Last week, a DJ popped up at Kottbusser Tor, and everyone joined in!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by their nonchalance during BART delays—while newbies are panicking, we're just checking the time and grabbing a taco.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a tuxedo wait for the 5-Fulton while juggling. Just another Tuesday in the Tenderloin, I guess. Muni really brings out the characters.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about the plazas, but the real magic is in the narrow streets, where you can still find a grandmother selling pastries from her kitchen.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones staring at the metro map like it’s a treasure map, usually blocking the entrance and asking the locals for directions.
